questions.question: Minimum Support Price for 2018-19 for Cotton of the Medium Staple variety is set at _______.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **__5150 per quintal__**.

__
 
• The MSP is the rate at which the government **buys grains from farmers.**
 
• The MSP is fixed on the recommendations of the **Commission for Agricultural Costs and Prices (CACP).**
 
• On 18th November 2004, the Union government formed the National Commission on Farmers (NCF) with **MS Swaminathan as its chairman.**

**The factors taken for MSP consideration are:**

 
• Demand and supply, Cost of production, Price trends in the market, both domestic and international, Inter-crop price parity, Terms of trade between agriculture and non-agriculture, A minimum of 50% as the margin over the cost of production etc. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **MSP **is announced before harvesting of crops.
 
• **Cabinet Committee of Economic Affairs **announces MSP on the recommendation of CACP.
 
• **2020-21 MSP for Kharif crops are-**
 
 
• Nigerseed - Rs. 755 per quintal
 
• Seasum - Rs 370 per quintal
 
• Urad - Rs 300 per quintal
 
• Cotton of long-staple - Rs. 275 per quintal.

questions.question: The relation between the period of a simple pendulum 'T' and its length 'L' is ______ (‘g' is the acceleration due to gravity)
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**option 1**__.

__
 
• **T=2π√L/g **is the time period of a simple pendulum. here L is the length of the pendulum and g is the acceleration due to gravity.
 
• **Simple Pendulum **-A mass suspended from a light string that can oscillate when displaced from its rest position.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

**Concept:**

__
 
• **Note **that when we compare two simple pendulums, one with 1 kg of a bob attached and the other with 100 of a bob attached with the same length of rope, then their time period will be the same because the Time period does not depend upon the mass of the bob.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• **The amplitude of Simple Pendulum **is the maximum displacement on either side of the mean position, which is called amplitude.
 
• **Oscillation **is the motion from one extreme to another extreme, is called one **oscillation**. Thus, one oscillation is half vibration.

questions.question: The concept of the Freedom of trade in India's Constitution is adopted from the Constitution of which country?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Australia**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Article 301 **talks about the freedom of trade, commerce, and Exchange throughout the country.
 
• It states that subject to other provisions under **Part XIII,** the freedom to carry on these activities shall be free.
 
• **Article 19 g** of the constitution gives to practice any profession or to carry on any occupation, trade, or business.
 
• **Section 92 of the Australian Constitution **says that there should be freedom of trade, commerce, and intercourse which may be carried out by ocean navigation or internal carriage.
 
• India has taken the concept of freedom of trade in India's constitution from the Australian constitution.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

questions.question: The best examples of which script are found in the rock-cut edicts of Asoka?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **__Brahmi__**.

__
 
• The Edicts of Ashoka are a collection of more than thirty inscriptions on the pillars, as well as boulders and cave walls.
 
• The edicts describe in detail Ashoka's view about **dhamma**, an earnest attempt to solve some of the problems that a complex society faced.
 
• These edicts were deciphered by British archaeologist and historian **James Prinsep.**
 
• These inscriptions proclaim Ashoka's adherence to the Buddhist philosophy which, as in Hinduism, is called **dharma**, "**Law**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The inscriptions of Ashoka are found with the following scripts:
 
 
• **Magadhi Prakrit using Brahmi Script** - in the central and eastern part of India
 
• **Prakrit using Kharoshti script** - in north and northwest
 
• **Greek and Aramaic** - in northwest India
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__** 

**Ashokan inscriptions are classified as below:**

 
• **Major Rock Edicts**: 14 Edicts and 2 separate ones found in Odisha; in **Prakrit and Greek. **
 
• **Major Pillar Edicts**: 7 Edicts, inscribed at the end of Ashoka's reign; in **Prakrit**.
 
• **Minor Rock Edict**s: Edicts inscribed at the beginning of Ashoka's reign; **in Prakrit, Greek and Aramaic. **
 
• **Minor Pillar Edicts**: Schism Edict, Queen's Edict, Rummindei Edict, Nigali Sagar Edict; in **Prakrit**.

questions.question: The atmosphere of Mars is mostly composed of ______
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **__Carbon dioxide__**.

__
 
• The atmosphere of Mars is mostly composed of **95.32 % Carbon dioxide.**
 
• **2.6 Percent of Molecular nitrogen and 1.9 per cent of Argon** are also present in the Mars Atmosphere.
 
• Methane, Sulfur dioxide is also present in the Mars atmosphere.
 
• It also contains trace levels of water vapour, oxygen, carbon monoxide, hydrogen, and other noble gases.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• The surface pressure of Mars is** 610 Pascals and its gravity is 1/3rd of earth.**
 
• One Martian day equals 24 hours 37 minutes.
 
• Mars has two moons viz. **Phobos and Deimos.**

**​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **The Mars Orbiter Mission (MOM) or Mangalyaan,** is a space probe launched by the Indian Space Research Organization on 5th November 2013.
 
• Mangalyaan was India's **first **interplanetary mission.
 
• MOM was launched aboard **PSLV C-25.**
